data.action: 端坐于战术展开的轮椅上，手抚长管重型狙击铳，目光沉着锐利
data.description: 【蕾缪安 · 靶场】战术射击靶场内，蕾缪安端坐于展开战术支架的特制轮椅上，纤细的手指沉稳地抚过长管重型狙击铳的枪机，冰蓝色的眼眸瞬间变得极其锐利——「即便身处轮椅之上，在两千米外的距离内，我的子弹也绝对不会允许任何威胁靠近你半步。」
data.promptProse: Lemuen sits calmly in her tactically deployed wheelchair at the Sankta long-distance firing range, one hand resting on the long sniper rifle across her lap as she checks holographic ballistic data. Dark overcoat, white shirt, black tie and warm lap blanket retain her outfit beneath the steady halo. The low dynamic view follows range lanes behind. Harsh daylight reflects along rifle and chair metal, casting crisp wheel shadows across the ground.
data.title: 蕾缪安 · 靶场
